caption:
May 5–6, Almaty Hub will host a two-day Building Unicorns workshop with Uri Levine - entrepreneur, investor, and co-founder of Waze and Moovit.

Uri Levine’s approach is simple, yet rarely put into practice: “fall in love with the problem, not the solution”. This is how strong technology companies are born.

Participation in a workshop is a unique opportunity to get firsthand insights from a person who stands behind:
- Waze - acquired by Google for $1.3 billion
- Moovit - acquired by Intel for $1 billion

📍 On May 5, an open workshop will be held for early-stage startups. Participants will explore:
• The journey from an idea to the first stages of growth: how to turn an idea into a product
• Business model and strategy
• Common mistakes at the start

📍 On May 6, a workshop will be held for startups at the scaling stage (participation is only by invitation). The workshop will focus on:
• Growth management
• Complex management decisions
• In-depth case analysis

Join us for the event:
📅 May 5
🕖 11:00 AM – 5:00 PM
📍 Almaty Hub, 24 Zenkov St. | 4th floor

Registration link is in the bio: @almaty.hub.02
